Weed in Chinatown & LES

Chinatown and the Lower East Side have about 1,650 products across four licensed dispensaries. CONBUD at 85 Delancey Street near Essex is the largest at about 650 products. Mighty Lucky at 259 Bowery near Houston is second at about 540, The Flowery's Chinatown store at 70 Canal Street is third at about 400, and KushKlub at 186 Orchard Street is the smallest, with about 60. CONBUD and Mighty Lucky are about a ten-minute walk apart, and KushKlub sits a few minutes from both.

Pre-rolls lead at 473 listings, followed by 406 edibles, 375 vapes and 292 flower options, plus 63 concentrates. The 20 topicals and 27 tinctures are more than most neighborhoods with a similar number of shops carry. CONBUD has the most flower here and deep Claybourne Co., Ayrloom, Ruby Farms and Off Hours runs. Mighty Lucky has the most edibles and concentrates in the neighborhood, with MFNY, Ayrloom, Ithaca Organics and STIIIZY among its biggest brands. The Flowery Chinatown leans on Jaunty, MFNY, Wizard Trees and Jetty Extracts, and KushKlub's short menu is mostly pre-rolls and edibles. 1906 Boost pouches at Mighty Lucky are among the cheapest items in the neighborhood.

Chinatown & LES FAQ
Is there a licensed dispensary in Chinatown?

Yes. The Flowery has a store at 70 Canal Street with about 400 products listed. Mighty Lucky on the Bowery and CONBUD on Delancey are both about a ten-minute walk from Canal Street.

What is the biggest dispensary on the Lower East Side?

CONBUD at 85 Delancey Street, with about 650 products, ahead of Mighty Lucky on the Bowery at about 540. CONBUD has more flower; Mighty Lucky has more edibles and concentrates. KushKlub on Orchard Street is much smaller, at about 60.

Is CONBUD near the Delancey-Essex subway?

Yes. 85 Delancey is a block from the Delancey Street and Essex Street station on the F, J, M and Z, and a short walk from the Williamsburg Bridge.
